Recorded limitation: The day was identified by the facsimile's own running head (Feria III post dominicam IV in Quadragesima) and by the station heading that opens the formulary, and this oration is the first Secreta the Missal prints inside that day's Mass, taken after that day's Ant. ad Introitum and before the next day's station heading; the marginal number was read on the page image. Every 1862 reading in this entry rests on that book's whole-book text layer alone - this repository holds no page images for its temporal run - so where that layer damages a word the letterforms are inferred from the 1922 Mame at the same place rather than read. The 1922 Mame's text layer is also noisy here (0.81); its reading was accepted where the 1862 and the 1962 target agree with it. Not checked: the Oratio super populum that the 1962 prints after this Mass's Postcommunion (not on this work list), the 1604 and the 1570, and whether the 1862 also prints this prayer elsewhere in its book.
